source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs, check Chassis information and detail information.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES assumes an inline FirmwareInventory array and selects names containing both UBB and FPGA with insecure curl; substring conjunction still does not prove the physical target, collection completeness, active/staged role or actual WebUI parity.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly adds exact UBB-FPGA binding, complete lifecycle evidence and strict no-update controls but leaves finite mapping/version inputs as a review decision.

old_problem: Multiple inventory records can include both UBB and FPGA text, and an AND-substring is still only a candidate filter. The UBB assembly identity/Status does not establish its FPGA firmware, and a displayed Version may be staged rather than active. The prior review fixed these risks but retained Pending for ordinary component/lifecycle/version configuration.
disposition_reason: Bind the exact FPGA instance within the approved UBB topology to durable firmware member identity, enumerate every firmware-inventory member/page, distinguish active/running from backup/staged/pending images under the vendor lifecycle model, and compare complete inventory with the actual WebUI and UBB-FPGA firmware matrix. No flash, activation, rollback or reset is part of this case.
decision_basis: XLSX row 968, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 969 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 969 / variant 112bf97fa18d1d33.

UBB assembly coverage and UBB_FPGA firmware coverage are independent: chassis manufacturer/model/status cannot substitute for FPGA SoftwareId/Version/lifecycle, and an FPGA version cannot prove the UBB assembly fields.

Redfish firmware inventory is a collection of member resources that may paginate. Complete traversal and member retrieval precede exact topology-backed target selection; the source's assumed `.FirmwareInventory[]` shape is not portable.

Version requires lifecycle context. The approved vendor map determines which record is active/running, backup, staged or pending activation; neither first/highest version nor naming establishes that role.

ED-02, ED-03, ED-07, ED-08, ED-12, ED-17, ED-19, ED-21 and ED-30 preserve exact target/lifecycle/evidence; ED-33 through ED-38 and ED-44 permit safe read-only parameterization while prohibiting cross-credit and firmware action.

test_case.test_name: Validate the exact UBB FPGA firmware component and active/staged lifecycle
test_case.purpose: Verify the precise FPGA physically associated with the Project-defined UBB is uniquely represented in complete BMC firmware inventory, its durable identity, active/running and any backup/staged firmware, health/state and updateability match the approved UBB-FPGA lifecycle matrix, and actual WebUI evidence agrees without using UBB assembly status as a substitute or changing firmware.
required_package: Immutable SUT/BMC/platform/firmware/WebUI identity and approved UBB physical topology showing the exact FPGA instance and durable association
Service-root-discovered UpdateService/FirmwareInventory or approved SoftwareInventory collection, supported schemas, pagination and complete member access
Authoritative UBB-FPGA mapping using SoftwareId, related component/topology link or vendor durable ID; UBB+FPGA name match is locator-only
Vendor lifecycle semantics defining active/running, backup, staged, pending activation, unsupported and stale records plus expected uniqueness
Approved UBB-FPGA firmware matrix with per-role Version/VersionScheme, SoftwareId, Status.State/Health, Updateable and applicable date/minimum-version expectations
Actual WebUI Inventory and LEDs UBB_FPGA row/detail mapping, trusted TLS/protected credentials, freshness/redaction and no-update audit controls
test_case.test_command: READ ONLY. Verify immutable target and approved UBB-to-FPGA topology. Discover the advertised FirmwareInventory/SoftwareInventory collection, traverse all pages and retrieve every `Members[].@odata.id`, preserving full redacted records; do not assume an inline array. Use UBB+FPGA text only to find candidates, then select the exact device through the approved durable SoftwareId/component relationship and reject unrelated FPGA records, the UBB chassis resource and SMC_FPGA. Record Id/Name, SoftwareId, Version, VersionScheme, Status.State/Health, Updateable, ReleaseDate, LowestSupportedVersion and target-advertised lifecycle/OEM fields when supported. Classify active/running, backup and staged/pending solely with documented vendor semantics and compare each to its own Project baseline. Capture the actual rendered WebUI Inventory and LEDs UBB_FPGA row/detail and reconcile identity/version/lifecycle/health within freshness tolerance. Repeat read fingerprints only; never upload/update/activate/rollback firmware, reset FPGA/BMC, reboot, power-cycle or clear logs.
test_case.expected_result: Complete inventory yields exactly one approved UBB FPGA component association, distinct from UBB assembly and SMC_FPGA. Its active/running version, identity and health exactly match the Project baseline; any backup/staged/pending record is separately labeled and matches its own expected state/version. Supported metadata is schema-valid, WebUI and API reconcile within freshness tolerance, no relevant member is missing/duplicated/unknown and no firmware, reset, power or management state changes.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete collection/member traversal, exact UBB-topology-backed FPGA binding, explicit active/backup/staged roles, exact expected version/health/updateability comparison and actual rendered WebUI evidence. A UBB+FPGA substring, UBB chassis status, first/highest version or version-only JSON cannot pass. Missing/duplicate/ambiguous component, staged version credited as active, unexplained null/unknown state, UI/API mismatch or wrong per-role version is FAIL. Missing mapping/lifecycle/version matrix is NOT READY, not Pending; no version expectation is invented.
safety_gate: Use only certificate-verified protected GET/read operations discovered from the service; never follow UpdateService actions or expose credentials/security-sensitive inventory.
Bind the FPGA to the approved UBB physical topology and durable component ID; conjunction substring matching remains candidate discovery only.
Keep UBB assembly identity/Status and UBB_FPGA firmware lifecycle as independent coverage and keep active/running, backup, staged and pending roles separate.
Prohibit firmware upload, SimpleUpdate, HTTP push, activation, rollback, FPGA/BMC reset, reboot, power action and log clearing.
Retain complete raw collection/member data and actual rendered WebUI evidence before normalization/redaction, including unsupported/null fields.
Stop on incomplete pagination, ambiguous target, unknown lifecycle, credential exposure or WebUI/API disagreement and do not automatically retry with update/reset.
expected_evidence: Immutable target and approved UBB-to-FPGA topology/durable member map with explicit UBB-assembly and SMC-FPGA separation
Complete paginated firmware/software inventory and protected full raw record for every UBB-FPGA-related member
Normalized per-role lifecycle matrix with SoftwareId, Version/VersionScheme, active/running, backup/staged, Status/Health, Updateable and exact baseline comparison
Actual rendered WebUI Inventory and LEDs UBB_FPGA row/detail visual artifacts with synchronized component/version/lifecycle timestamps
Explicit rejection of other UBB/FPGA candidates and accounting for missing/null/unsupported/stale fields
Pre/post fingerprints, preserved SEL/audit logs, no-update/no-activate/no-reset/no-power proof and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is intended. On incomplete inventory, ambiguous UBB-FPGA association, unknown lifecycle, version mismatch or WebUI/API disagreement, stop and preserve/redact evidence and obtain the authoritative topology/lifecycle matrix. Do not upload, update, activate, roll back, reset, reboot, power-cycle, clear logs or automatically retry.

source_conflict.reason: Master clearly targets UBB_FPGA information in WebUI. DeepSeek's substring selection and assumed collection shape are incomplete implementation guidance, not a conflicting component.

blocked.reason: Exact-target UBB FPGA firmware inventory is technically defined. Topology, lifecycle semantics and version baseline are bounded Project prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: UBB-to-FPGA topology/durable member map; actual inventory collection/schema; active/backup/staged lifecycle semantics; expected per-role versions/health/updateability; WebUI mapping; trust, freshness and redaction.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; READ-ONLY UBB_FPGA FIRMWARE INVENTORY ONLY; NO REDFISH, WEBUI, UPDATE, RESET, POWER OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
